title: Sample-Based Prophet Inequalities for Random Walks
summary: We study prophet inequalities for a random walk reward stopping problem with sample-based information. The goal is to stop as close as possible to the maximum of a random walk with i.i.d. increments, measuring performance by the ratio between the expected reward when stopping and the expected true maximum. We consider a sample-based model in which the increment distribution is unknown and the decision maker has access to $K$ independent sample paths of the reward process.
